details:
I'd like to provide some accessibility suggestions, specifically regarding how information is displayed, scaled, and accessed.

For context, I have rather poor eyesight (though this is no form of blindness or colour-blindness). I require contact lenses or glasses 24/7, and my prescription is strong enough that a lot of VR Lens makers do not support my eyesight. I use my contact lenses for VR, or lens inserts if they're available for my headset in my prescription.

I'd also like to mention I do not have these issues with most other VR and Desktop games, as they usually include the below, or are adequate enough by default.

Problems I am having:

- Text size in general across the menu's now seems to be smaller and much harder to read.

- Some text is hard to read on user's Nameplates and profiles due to customisation features. This is especially prominent for Nameplates.

- Nameplate customisation makes choosing the opacity for them (existing feature) much harder to do, due to varying colours and such.

- Nameplates are harder to read, due to the new way information is laid out. Profile pictures are significantly harder to see too now.

- Information on user profiles is now harder or slower to find (e.g. languages or represented group)

- Trying to access my own Profile from the quick menu (side bar, pop out menu), I end up clicking to edit my banner instead as the button is just as big, if not bigger, than the section where you can access your profile.

- Showing and hiding avatars now need scrolling to see the option. When lagging or having to quickly view or hide someone's avi, this is a killer, and worse than the previous UI

On profiles especially, information is less clear than the previous UI. Having 2 columns formatted like this doesn't make sense to me. For example, I believe how badges and groups are displayed need swapping on profiles. Icons/Badges have already been designed in a way where they're obvious from a glance, and when they're small. Groups don't really do the same, especially with how small their icons are. I'd also say that languages need to visible as soon as you open a users profile, as this is how we need to navigate communication, especially when meeting new people in this social game.

Possible Solutions:

- The ability to scale the text size in the menus

- The ability for myself to customise what information is displayed in everyone's Nameplates

- Better scaling of information included Nameplates

- Overriding other users customisation settings in Nameplates and Profiles

- Making a bigger emphasis on critical information on profiles / Making it quicker to find (e.g. Languages)

- Remove editing banner and pfp from the quick menu and just have it take me to my profile, as I can edit this stuff in that menu already.

Overall I like the aesthetic of the new UI (albeit it's not as unique as the previous), but the layout, scaling, and choice of what information is displayed where, needs further consideration.
title: [1878] Further Accessibility features needed for the new beta UI (Eyesight & Information displayed)
